overview.overview:
Maine's 2nd Congressional District is projected to lean Republican in 2028, with an expected margin of about 4 points. The district backed the Republican presidential candidate by 7.4 points in 2020 and by 9.0 points in 2024, and it has been more Republican than the nation as a whole in both elections.

The plausible range runs from a 14-point Republican margin to a 6-point Democratic margin, so the outcome is not fixed. The district carries one electoral vote, and it is not expected to decide the national result. No candidate-specific polling or home-state candidate effects are available for this district.
overview.watch: Any district-level polling showing a sustained move away from the 2024 margin, or a notable shift in the national environment, could change the outlook here.
key_factors: Republican margins of 7.4 points in 2020 and 9.0 points in 2024
A lean roughly 8.5 points more Republican than the national baseline
Projected national environment shift of 4.5 points
No district-specific polling or home-state candidate effects available
